brineš: brinuti — to worry, care; 2nd pers. sg.
da: conjunction: that, so that; da + verb = infinitive («da vidim» — to see); also «yes»
daćemo: dati — to give; future 1st pers. pl.
dobro: dobro veče — good evening; dobro je što — good thing that
druge: drugi; gen. case fem.: s druge strane — on the other hand
družiš: družiti se — to hang out, socialize; 2nd pers. sg.
evo: evo ga — here he is; evo nas — here we are
ga: short form of njega; «ili ti ga» — «or, in other words» (colloquial)
gde: gde si — hi, how are you (colloquial)
i: conjunction; before the word — «and, also, even»
ide: ići — to go, to ride; gde se ide — where you need to go
idemo: ići — to go, to ride; 1st pers. pl.
ili: conjunction; «ili ti ga» — «or, in other words» (colloquial)
ima: imati — to have; ima = «there is, there exists»
inače: adverb: actually, by the way; otherwise
je: biti — to be, 3rd pers. sg.; auxiliary verb past; je l' — «really, or what»
kakve: kakav; kakve veze ima — what connection
koja: koji — which; fem.; also «which» (koja su to sela)
leži: ležati — to lie; gde se leži — where they lie
ljutiš: ljutiti se — to be angry; 2nd pers. sg.
ma: intensifying particle: ma nemoguće — no way
mi: mi — we; short form «me» (potreban mi je — I need)
molim: moliti — to ask; molim te — please
nego: brže nego što — faster than; pre nego što — before
neka: neki — some, a certain; fem. sg. or neut. pl.
nemoj: negative command: nemoj da promašiš — don't miss
nisam: negation of auxiliary verba, 1st pers. sg.
nisi: negation of auxiliary verba, 2nd pers. sg.
ništa: at the beginning of a sentence — «well then, anyway»
od: preposition + gen. case: jedno od naselja — one of the settlements
pa: particle at the start of a line — «well»; conjunction — «and, therefore»
paziš: paziti — to look after, be careful; 2nd pers. sg.
po: po mraku — in the dark; po jedan — one by one; dva i po — two and a half
razmišlja: razmišljati — to think, ponder; 3rd pers. sg.
riknu: riknuti — to croak, die (colloquial); 3rd pers. pl.
sa: preposition + instr. case; + gen. case — «with, from» (sa mape — from the map)
sad: = sada; e sad — well then, so
sam: biti, 1st pers. sg.: rekao sam — I said
se: reflexive particle: slikamo se — we take photos of ourselves
si: biti, 2nd pers. sg.; gde si — hi, how are you (colloquial)
sva: sav — all; sva sela — all the villages; sva sreća — fortunately
ti: pronoun; «ili ti ga» — «or, in other words» (colloquial)
tome: to; loc. case: po tome što — by the fact that
treba: trebati — to be needed; treba ti — you need
u: preposition: + loc. case — where, + acc. case — where to
upoznamo: upoznati — to get acquainted; 1st pers. pl.
veze: veza — connection; nemam (blage) veze — I have no idea (colloquial)
znači: značiti — to mean; as an introductory word — «so, in short»
ćeš: hteti; aux. verb future, 2nd pers. sg.
čačka: čačkati — to pick, poke; 3rd pers. sg.
čoveče: čovek — person; voc. case; as an exclamation — «wow, you're something»
što: conjunction «what»; colloquial question «of what, why» (što si se sredio?)
